title: Divide the countries list into two halves
description:
Divide the countries list into two equal lists if it is even if not one more country for the first half.

Python-Gym adaptation: implement as split_countries_in_half(countries), returning a tuple (first_half, second_half) where, if countries has an odd length, first_half gets the extra item.
hints: The size of the first half depends on whether the total count is even or odd.
For an odd count, the first half should be one item longer than the second half.
Compute first_len = len(countries) // 2 + len(countries) % 2, then return (countries[:first_len], countries[first_len:]).
expected_behavior: Returns a tuple of two lists splitting countries in half, with the first half getting the extra item when the length is odd.
explanation: len(countries) // 2 + len(countries) % 2 rounds the first half's size up when the total is odd, and slicing at that boundary produces both halves.
